description: Defines the FocusResolver class responsible for managing window focus states per display in Android input dispatcher, including focus policy, focus requests, and focus tracking.

classes.name: FocusResolver
classes.description: Manages focus state of windows per display, handles focus requests, and provides focus change notifications.

methods.name: getFocusedWindowToken
methods.description: Returns the focused window token for a given display.

methods.name: setInputWindows
methods.description: Updates the input windows for a display and returns focus change info.

methods.name: setFocusedWindow
methods.description: Sets the focus to a specific window based on a focus request.

methods.name: displayRemoved
methods.description: Cleans up references when a display is removed.

methods.name: hasFocusedWindowTokens
methods.description: Checks if there are any focused window tokens.

methods.name: dumpFocusedWindows
methods.description: Returns a string dump of current focused windows.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string dump of the focus resolver state.

methods.name: isTokenFocusable
methods.description: Checks if a window token can be focused on a display.

methods.name: getResolvedFocusWindow
methods.description: Resolves which window can receive focus for a token.

methods.name: getFocusRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the current focus request for a display.
